CREATE TABLE tz_authoring_job (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    idempotency_key uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    request_hash varchar(71) NOT NULL,
    request_json jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(request_json) = 'object'),
    status varchar(32) NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('PLANNED', 'GENERATING', 'VERIFYING', 'READY', 'FAILED')),
    attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts BETWEEN 0 AND 5),
    lease_token uuid,
    lease_expires_at timestamptz,
    artifact_json jsonb CHECK (artifact_json IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(artifact_json) = 'object'),
    failure_code varchar(64) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    CHECK (request_hash ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    CHECK ((status = 'READY' AND artifact_json IS NOT NULL) OR status <> 'READY'),
    CHECK ((status IN ('GENERATING', 'VERIFYING') AND lease_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL)
        OR (status NOT IN ('GENERATING', 'VERIFYING') AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL))
);

CREATE INDEX tz_authoring_job_recovery_idx
    ON tz_authoring_job(status, lease_expires_at, updated_at)
    WHERE status IN ('PLANNED', 'GENERATING', 'VERIFYING', 'FAILED');
